## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

## Title

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

`r format(Sys.time(), format = "%d-%m-%Y")`

## Description or Purpose

To combine all results from complex heatmaps in Figure 2C and 2D into a table.

### Data sources

- Figure 2 pairwise correlations based on Recon3D genes - Pearson correlations
- Figure 2 pairwise correlations based on Reactome genes - Pearson correlations
- Figure 2 correlations between gene expression and EMT scores and proliferation rates.

## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(writexl)
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Tables_{datestamp}")))
```

Open all correlations files from Figure 2.

```{r}
data_dir <- find_most_recent_folder("Figure2", here("manuscript"))
print(data_dir)
recon3d_gene_correlations <- read_csv(here("manuscript", data_dir, "Figure2C.csv"))
recon3d_phenotype_correlations <- read_csv(here("manuscript", data_dir, "Figure2C_correlations.csv"))

reactome_gene_correlations <- read_csv(here("manuscript", data_dir, "Figure2D.csv"))
reactome_phenotype_correlations <- read_csv(here("manuscript", data_dir, "Figure2D_correlations.csv"))
```

### Write to supplementary Table

```{r}
excel_sheets <- list(
  "recon3d_gene_pairwise_correlations"   = recon3d_gene_correlations,
  "recon3d_gene_phenotype_correlations"  = recon3d_phenotype_correlations,
  "reactome_gene_pairwise_correlations"  = reactome_gene_correlations,
  "reactome_gene_phenotype_correlations" = reactome_phenotype_correlations
)
write_xlsx(excel_sheets, here(output_dir, "Supplementary_Table_3.xlsx"))
```

## Conclusion

Supplementary Table 3 was created.
